metadata.question: Was the total rainfall in Grafton, New South Wales, greater than the total rainfall in Canberra from January 15, 2020 to January 21, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Question: Compare total rainfall between Grafton, NSW and Canberra from Jan 15-21, 2020. 2. Data: Use CHIRPS precipitation data (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) 3. Locations: - Grafton, NSW: approx (-29.681, 152.932) - Canberra: approx (-35.2809, 149.1300) 4. Strategy: - Create point geometries for both locations - Get CHIRPS daily precipitation data for the date range - Sum precipitation over time for each location - Compare the totals 5. Checks: - Ensure collection has data (C1 if empty) - Check if valid pixels exist (C2 if 0) - Validate results aren't NaN/None (C3 if invalid) CHIRPS data has 'precipitation' band in mm. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const grafton = ee.Geometry.Point([152.932, -29.681]); const canberra = ee.Geometry.Point([149.1300, -35.2809]); const startDate = '2020-01-15'; const endDate = '2020-01-21'; // 2. Data Acquisition const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('precipitation'); const collectionSize = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images in date range: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate total rainfall for each location const graftonRainfall = chirps.sum().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: grafton, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); const canberraRainfall = chirps.sum().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: canberra, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); // 4. Get values and validate const graftonVal = graftonRainfall.getInfo(); const canberraVal = canberraRainfall.getInfo(); console.log(`Grafton total rainfall: ${graftonVal?.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Canberra total rainfall: ${canberraVal?.toFixed(2)} mm`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (graftonVal === null || canberraVal === null || isNaN(graftonVal) || isNaN(canberraVal)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (graftonVal > canberraVal) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
